mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, pay_amount, refund_amount, net_pay_amount, product_cost, bonus_amount, company_share_amount, company_profit, risk_status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_order_finance WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_order_finance.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId})

mapper.update: UPDATE dms_order_finance SET order_no = #{finance.orderNo}, pay_amount = #{finance.payAmount}, refund_amount = #{finance.refundAmount}, net_pay_amount = #{finance.netPayAmount}, product_cost = #{finance.productCost}, bonus_amount = #{finance.bonusAmount}, company_share_amount = #{finance.companyShareAmount}, company_profit = #{finance.companyProfit}, risk_status = #{finance.riskStatus}, remark = #{finance.remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{finance.orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_order_finance.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId})
